description: Unit tests for CryptoUtils in the quiche QUIC implementation, testing handshake failure reasons, encryption tag lengths, version validation, and cryptographic label correctness.

classes.name: CryptoUtilsTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for CryptoUtils unit tests.

methods.name: HandshakeFailureReasonToString
methods.description: Converts handshake failure reason enum to string.

methods.name: AuthTagLengths
methods.description: Tests the expected authentication tag lengths for different versions and algorithms.

methods.name: ValidateChosenVersion
methods.description: Validates that the chosen version matches the expected version.

methods.name: ValidateServerVersionsNoVersionNegotiation
methods.description: Checks server version validation when no version negotiation is involved.

methods.name: ValidateServerVersionsWithVersionNegotiation
methods.description: Checks server version validation with version negotiation.

methods.name: ValidateServerVersionsWithDowngrade
methods.description: Ensures downgrade attacks are detected when server version is older than client supported versions.

methods.name: ValidateCryptoLabels
methods.description: Verifies cryptographic labels and keys against known test vectors for different QUIC versions.
